record.search_frame: Registered evidence classes and sources for the bounded example investigation.

established.statement: The registered observation occurred in the frozen case.

conditionally_established.statement: The observation has the recorded interpretation if assumption A holds.

supported_not_established.statement: A broader mechanism is compatible with the evidence but not demonstrated.

unknown.statement: Whether the mechanism generalizes outside the frozen case.
unknown.reason: No external cases were in the frozen search frame.

not_identifiable_from_current_evidence.statement: Which of two observationally equivalent mechanisms generated the event.
not_identifiable_from_current_evidence.reason: The frozen evidence has identical predictions under both mechanisms.

explicit_nonclaims.statement: The result is not a population estimate.

falsifiers.statement: A source-valid observation showing the registered event did not occur.

surviving_propositions.statement: A narrower case-specific proposition remains supported.
